verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-risk decisioning platform, so passing verified agent identity into risk decisions is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes, or any agent-identity signal. The only nearby capability is generic custom events and fields (sift-docs-10), which lets a developer send arbitrary data but is not first-class, verified agent identity support.
